ev.q: Tribes of Midgard is an action role-playing survival video game
collecting resources used for crafting new weapons, armor, and village defenses
players can also form a tribe of 10 players and play cooperatively
protect the seed of Yggdrasil from enemies such as Helthings, dark elves, trolls and giants
During day time, the player explores a procedurally generated world
At night time, the enemies will attack the player's settlement in an attempt to destroy the seed of Yggdrasil
